seo.title: Wkil | Your AI operator for business and social media
seo.description: Tell Wkil what your business needs. It plans content, writes and publishes posts, and handles customer conversations from one chat.
seo.openGraphTitle: Wkil | Tell it what to do. It gets the work done.
seo.openGraphDescription: One chat to plan content, publish posts, and handle customer conversations in your brand voice.

hero.title: Tell Wkil what to do. It gets the work done.
hero.subtitle: Your AI teammate for business and social media. Wkil plans your content, writes and publishes posts, handles customer conversations, and keeps you in control when a decision is needed.

items.title: From idea to published post
items.text: Ask for a content plan, get the posts written, then let Wkil schedule or publish them after your approval.

items.title: Customer conversations handled
items.text: Wkil replies using what it knows about your business, captures interested customers, and brings you the conversations that need you.

items.title: A teammate that knows your work
items.text: Give Wkil your website, services, FAQs, and brand voice. Every task starts with the context that makes your work yours.

chat.title: Watch Wkil take a task from request to result
chat.initialMessage: Tell me what you want done. I can plan content, write and publish posts, or handle customer conversations.
prompts: Create and publish a week of posts
Reply to customers asking about our offer
chat.ctaText: Ready to put Wkil to work?

pricing.title: Clear pricing in EGP. Meta fees go straight to Meta.
pricing.subtitle: Every plan includes Wkil replying in your voice with AI, confirming WhatsApp orders, following up with customers, and writing your posts. A conversation is one customer within 24 hours, however many messages they send.
pricing.billingNote: Prices in Egyptian pounds per month. Pay yearly, get two months free, and your price stays fixed for 12 months.

plans.name: Free
plans.tagline: Try Wkil on your website and Messenger
features: Knowledge base for your business (website, services, FAQs)
"Powered by Wkil" badge on the chat

plans.name: Starter
plans.tagline: For the founder who still replies alone
features: WhatsApp (1 number) + Messenger + Instagram + web chat
300 WhatsApp order confirmations per month (up to 10 orders a day) with Confirm / Cancel buttons
Automatic follow-ups for customers who went quiet

plans.name: Growth
plans.tagline: For the brand that gets orders every day: covers a full reply shift
features: All channels: WhatsApp + Messenger + Instagram + web chat
2,000 WhatsApp order confirmations per month (up to 65 orders a day)
Automatic follow-ups + lead capture and memory for every customer
5 users and handoff to your team with a mobile push
CRM and external systems: the agent runs actions during the chat

plans.name: Scale
plans.tagline: For several brands or a full team
plans.cta: Start and we set it up with you
features: 3 WhatsApp numbers and 3 businesses in one account
5,000 WhatsApp order confirmations per month (numbers above 100 confirmations a day need Meta business verification, which we set up with you)
Custom setup with the Wkil team

overage.title: Outgrew your plan this month?
overage.text: We tell you before you reach your plan's limit. After that, extra conversations cost EGP 1 each and extra order confirmations EGP 0.50 each. More than 5,000 orders a month? Talk to us.

meta.title: WhatsApp fees go straight to Meta
meta.text: Meta bills your own account directly, with no markup from Wkil: about EGP 0.25 per confirmation message, and about EGP 0.25 per WhatsApp reply after the first 1,000 messages each month. Messenger, Instagram and web chat carry no Meta fees.

agency.title: An agency or managing several clients?
agency.text: If you run pages for several clients, talk to us and we will price a plan by the number of clients.
agency.cta: Sign up and message us inside Wkil

pricing.trialNote: Try Starter or Growth free for 14 days, no card needed. Cancel any time from your account.

cta.title: Give Wkil a task and let it take care of the steps

signup.title: Ready to put Wkil to work?
signup.subtitle: Create your account and start with a conversation. Setup takes a few minutes.
signup.note: You can add your website, services, and brand voice during onboarding. Wkil will use them to carry out your tasks.
